connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: A connection to a SOAP server using async I/O via HttpClientIo with automatic protocol negotiation (HTTP/3, HTTP/2, HTTP/1.1)
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: 使用 HttpClientIo 透過非同步 I/O 連線至 SOAP 伺服器，並自動協商通訊協定（HTTP/3、HTTP/2、HTTP/1.1）

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: SOAP (Async I/O) Connection
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: SOAP（非同步 I/O）連線

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: Send SOAP requests as MTOM/XOP packages: `base64Binary` content of at least `mtom_threshold` octets travels as binary MIME parts instead of base64 text, which shortens large document and image uploads. MTOM responses are always accepted.
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: 將 SOAP 請求以 MTOM/XOP 套件傳送：`base64Binary` 內容至少 `mtom_threshold` 個位元組會以二進位 MIME 部分傳輸，而非 base64 文字，可縮短大型文件和影像上傳。MTOM 回應一律接受。

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: MTOM Requests
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: MTOM 請求

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: Send requests as MTOM/XOP packages
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: 以 MTOM/XOP 套件傳送請求

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: The minimum size in octets of `base64Binary` content sent as a binary MTOM part; `0` sends every value as a part. Applies only when `mtom` is `True`.
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: 以二進位 MTOM 部分傳送的 `base64Binary` 內容最小大小（以八位組計）；`0` 會將所有值都作為部分傳送。僅當 `mtom` 為 `True` 時才適用。

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: MTOM Part Threshold
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: MTOM 部分閾值

connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.source: The smallest binary value sent as an MTOM part
connection.U29hcENsaWVudElv.scheme.U29hc.message: 以 MTOM 部分傳送的最小二進位值
